title: IntelliJ & Copilot
summary: A supervised entry point for repository investigation and implementation.

sections.label: Useful work
sections.text: Inspect affected modules, edit a bounded change, run local checks, and prepare review evidence in the actual checkout.

sections.label: Current distinction
sections.text: JetBrains’ September update includes session-model selection for built-in subagents. Independent per-agent routing still depends on the harness. Do not transplant SDK configuration assumptions into every IDE mode.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Record the effective client, plugin, harness, model, and permitted tools. Verify execution evidence against the resulting revision.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
